documents.text: Hacktoberfest Hack Day x IUL takes place on 15 and 16 October 2026. The daily schedule is 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM. The venue is B-Block, LT-8.
The Hack Day focuses on open source, building with open-source AI, hands-on learning, and learning with fellow developers.
The event is beginner friendly. Day 1 includes a Git and GitHub onboarding workshop for people with zero experience.
The event information lists cash prizes, winner trophies, official certificates for attendees, official swags and stickers, food, and refreshments across both days.
The registration link provided by the team is https://shorturl.at/3Kgok. The event information says participant seats are limited to 70 to 80.
